economic_thesis: High-volume price moves unexplained by rolling BTC beta and reinforced by same-side perpetual funding partly reflect temporary forced-flow impact. Diversified long and short exhaustion tails should earn subsequent liquidity-provision reversal.

expected_regime_roles.bear: Shift five percentage points of gross from long to short; crowded positive residual relief rallies should feed the short sleeve.
expected_regime_roles.bull: Shift five percentage points of gross from short to long; forced-sale pullbacks should feed the long sleeve.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Use symmetric sleeves; repeated idiosyncratic overshoots are the primary expected return source.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Buy negative beta-residual, high-volume exhaustion, strengthened by negative funding crowding.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Short positive beta-residual, high-volume exhaustion, strengthened by positive funding crowding.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Diversification and unlevered gross limit exposure, but falling-knife risk is explicit and must be tested with separate controls.

falsifier: Reject for causal or deterministic failure. Reject this iteration without risk rescue if the base has nonpositive OOF Sharpe, fewer than four positive folds, nonpositive bull/bear/chop return, failed long-bull or short-bear roles, nonpositive doubled-cost Sharpe, or drawdown above 40%.
mechanism: Daily cross-sectional reversal of high-volume idiosyncratic shocks after removing rolling BTC beta, with funding crowding confirmation and a slow BTC trend gross tilt.
risk_policy_plan: Start with no control. Only after a positive base screen, separately register volatility-target, drawdown-brake, turnover-limit, and combined ablations; run each at base and doubled costs.
selection_metric: Noncompensatory causal/regime/sleeve/cost/stability gates, then median fold Sharpe; drawdown and turnover are tie-breakers.
